name: Wolfpine Village Modular and Finishing Candidate Ledger
purpose: Tracks Batch 02 modular architecture/clutter candidates and Batch 03 ground/depth finishing candidates before promotion into the canonical Wolfpine Village kit.

source_policy.notes: Do not promote candidates into canonical asset paths until source, license/generation notes, cleanup status, and review status are recorded.

candidates.source_notes: Generate from Batch 02 prompt card. Record tool/model/date/settings before promotion.
cleanup_notes: Crop with margin for facade overlay use.
Preserve ground-level threshold shadow.
Normalize perspective to Batch 01 building facades.
review_notes: Reject if it reads as a window or hatch instead of a door.
Reject if perspective does not match the facade ground plane.
Reject if it looks pasted-on after overlay testing.

candidates.source_notes: Generate from Batch 02 prompt card. Record tool/model/date/settings before promotion.
cleanup_notes: Crop with transparent-ready margin.
Keep window visibly smaller than Batch 02 heavy door.
Normalize timber/plaster edge treatment for facade overlay.
review_notes: Reject if it can be mistaken for a door.
Reject if glow becomes too bright or horror-like.
Reject if repeated copies create obvious pattern noise.

candidates.source_notes: Generate from Batch 02 prompt card. Record tool/model/date/settings before promotion.
cleanup_notes: Crop with repeat-friendly side margins.
Remove hard background edges.
Check repeat readability with mirrored and offset copies.
review_notes: Reject if it reads as a solid wall instead of low fence.
Reject if it blocks required route readability when used on path edges.
Reject if perspective drifts from the village ground plane.

candidates.source_notes: Generate from Batch 02 prompt card. Record tool/model/date/settings before promotion.
cleanup_notes: Crop tightly enough for compact clutter placement.
Normalize contact shadow.
Simplify noisy log edges if needed.
review_notes: Reject if it becomes too large for doorway-side dressing.
Reject if silhouette is unreadable at game scale.
Reject if it cannot sit beside forge and cottage facades.

candidates.source_notes: Generate from Batch 02 prompt card. Record tool/model/date/settings before promotion.
cleanup_notes: Crop with small transparent margin.
Remove readable markings if generated accidentally.
Normalize barrel scale against crate candidate.
review_notes: Reject if it looks modern or metal-industrial.
Reject if it has readable labels or symbols.
Reject if it is too large for repeated clutter dressing.

candidates.source_notes: Generate from Batch 02 prompt card. Record tool/model/date/settings before promotion.
cleanup_notes: Crop with small transparent margin.
Remove readable markings if generated accidentally.
Normalize scale against barrel candidate.
review_notes: Reject if perspective does not match the ground plane.
Reject if it has readable text or shipping marks.
Reject if edges are too pixel-sharp or too blurry.

candidates.source_notes: Generate from Batch 03 prompt card. Record tool/model/date/settings before promotion.
cleanup_notes: Keep transparent-ready soft edges.
Reduce contrast if it pops above buildings and props.
Test repeated placement along mud/cobble edges.
review_notes: Reject if vegetation is neon or high-fantasy saturated.
Reject if repeated copies create obvious tiling.
Reject if it reads as a collision object by default.

candidates.source_notes: Generate from Batch 03 prompt card. Record tool/model/date/settings before promotion.
cleanup_notes: Remove any hard rectangular crop boundary.
Keep decal subtle enough for gameplay readability.
Test over road, mud, and cobble bases.
review_notes: Reject if it looks like a sticker.
Reject if it obscures path readability.
Reject if it resembles modern tire marks.

candidates.source_notes: Generate from Batch 03 prompt card. Record tool/model/date/settings before promotion.
cleanup_notes: Preserve natural transparent gaps between needles and branches.
Keep focus softer than gameplay objects.
Test against doors, exits, and hotspot markers before promotion.
review_notes: Reject if it hides doors, exits, or important hotspots.
Reject if it reads as a ground prop instead of foreground occluder.
Reject if it dominates the scene edge too strongly.
